title: 11 Best Herbal Teas For Neck Pain
description: Valeriana officinalis teas have been traditionally used to treat neck pain due to their analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and sedative properties. The bioactive constituents present in these teas, including valerenic acid, isovaleric acid, and valepotriates, help to reduce inflammation and alleviate pain in the neck region.
